maddeler.e:
أتناضح (form VI)
# أَتَنَاضَحُ (ʔatanāḍaḥu) /ʔa.ta.naː.dˤa.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَنَاضَحَ (tanāḍaḥa)
# أَتَنَاضَحَ (ʔatanāḍaḥa) /ʔa.ta.naː.dˤa.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاضَحَ (tanāḍaḥa)
# أَتَنَاضَحْ (ʔatanāḍaḥ) /ʔa.ta.naː.dˤaħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَنَاضَحَ (tanāḍaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
